description: Index manifest for simulate-user ground-truth seed datasets.

ui_ux_design.description: UI/UX design critique, button and friction consolidation, stale post-action control elimination, staying anchored to chosen visual references, house tokens, and customer fairness.

momentum_execution.description: Direct configuration answers first, parallel exploratory checks while debugging, and decisive terse approvals with targeted constraints.
